datasets.displayName: coffee shop sales summary with time and revenue buckets
queryLines:
USE CATALOG `workspace`;
USE SCHEMA `default`;

---1. Create a view with calculated total_amount for reuse
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW coffee_sales_clean AS
SELECT 
    *,
    transaction_qty * CAST(REPLACE(unit_price, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) AS total_amount,
    CASE
        WHEN HOUR(transaction_time) BETWEEN 6 AND 11 THEN 'Morning'
        WHEN HOUR(transaction_time) BETWEEN 12 AND 16 THEN 'Afternoon'
        WHEN HOUR(transaction_time) BETWEEN 17 AND 21 THEN 'Evening'
        ELSE 'Night'
    END AS transaction_time_bucket,
    CASE
        WHEN transaction_qty * CAST(REPLACE(unit_price, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) < 10 THEN 'Low Sale'
        WHEN transaction_qty * CAST(REPLACE(unit_price, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) BETWEEN 10 AND 20 THEN 'Medium Sale'
        ELSE 'High Sale'
    END AS sales_category
FROM bright.coffee.shop;

---1.Checking dataset

Select * 
from bright.coffee.shop;

--2.Checking rows
Select count (*) as number_of_rows
from bright.coffee.shop;


----3.Caluclating Total Revenue, Convert unit_price from string to decimal

SELECT ROUND(SUM(transaction_qty * TRY_CAST(REPLACE(unit_price, ',','.') AS DOUBLE)),2) AS Total_Revenue
FROM bright.coffee.shop;

---4.Checking distinct branches
Select DISTINCT store_location,
                 store_id
from bright.coffee.shop;

---5.Checking distinct prodcut categories
Select DISTINCT product_category
from bright.coffee.shop;


---6.Checking distinct product types

Select DISTINCT product_type
from bright.coffee.shop;


---7.Checking highest and lowest unit price use cast...

Select ROUND(TRY_CAST(REPLACE(MIN(UNIT_PRICE), ',', '.') AS DOUBLE), 2) AS Lowest_UnitPrice,
    ROUND(TRY_CAST(REPLACE(MAX(unit_price), ',', '.') AS DOUBLE), 2) AS Highest_UnitPrice
    from bright.coffee.shop;


----8. Check start and end date of the transactions
Select MIN (transaction_date) as First_Transaction,
    MAX (transaction_date) as Latest_Transaction
    from bright.coffee.shop;




---9.Check for duplicate records (zero duplicates)
SELECT *,
COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count
FROM bright.coffee.shop
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

----10. Check for missing values
SELECT
SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS transaction_id_nulls,
SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS transaction_date_nulls,
SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS transaction_time_nulls,
SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_qty IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS transaction_qty_nulls,
SUM(CASE WHEN unit_price IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unit_price_nulls
FROM bright.coffee.shop


---11.Checking the Total revenue by store location
SELECT DISTINCT store_location,
        ROUND(SUM(transaction_qty * TRY_CAST(REPLACE(unit_price, ',','.') AS DOUBLE)),2) AS Total_Revenue
FROM bright.coffee.shop
GROUP BY store_location
ORDER BY Total_Revenue;

---12. Checking unit price 
SELECT DISTINCT unit_price
FROM bright.coffee.shop
LIMIT 20;


--13. Creating 3-hour time bucket

SELECT *,
CASE
        WHEN HOUR(transaction_time) BETWEEN 6 AND 11 THEN 'Morning'
        WHEN HOUR(transaction_time) BETWEEN 12 AND 16 THEN 'Afternoon'
        WHEN HOUR(transaction_time) BETWEEN 17 AND 21 THEN 'Evening'
        ELSE 'Night'
        END AS Transaction_Time_Bucket
FROM bright.coffee.shop;


---14.Extract the dayname, montname, weekday and hour from the timestamp
     
Select 
    HOUR(transaction_time) AS transaction_hour,
    DAYNAME(transaction_date) AS transaction_dayname,
    WEEKDAY(transaction_date) AS transaction_weekday,
    MONTHNAME(transaction_date) AS transaction_month
from bright.coffee.shop;


---15. Extract Wekkend vs Weekday

SELECT CASE
        WHEN DAYOFWEEK(transaction_date) IN (1,7)
        THEN 'Weekend'
        ELSE 'Weekday'
        END AS Day_Type
FROM bright.coffee.shop;

---16. Sales Catergory according to total amount

SELECT transaction_qty * CAST(REPLACE(unit_price, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) AS total_amount
FROM bright.coffee.shop;
   
--17. Creating sales buckets

SELECT
    MIN(transaction_qty * CAST(REPLACE(unit_price, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE)) AS min_sale,
    MAX(transaction_qty * CAST(REPLACE(unit_price, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE)) AS max_sale,
    ROUND(AVG(transaction_qty * CAST(REPLACE(unit_price, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS avg_sale
FROM bright.coffee.shop;

SELECT
    *,
    transaction_qty * CAST(REPLACE(unit_price, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) AS total_amount,
    CASE
        WHEN transaction_qty * CAST(REPLACE(unit_price, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) < 10 THEN 'Low Sale'
        WHEN transaction_qty * CAST(REPLACE(unit_price, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) BETWEEN 10 AND 20 THEN 'Medium Sale'
        ELSE 'High Sale'
    END AS sales_category
FROM bright.coffee.shop;













---------------------Final CTE code-------------------------------------------------------------------------


-- ==========================================
-- Bright Coffee Shop Sales Analysis
-- Step 1: Data Cleaning & Transformation
-- ==========================================

WITH coffee_sales_clean AS (

SELECT
    transaction_id,
    transaction_date,
    transaction_time,
    transaction_qty,
    store_id,
    store_location,
    product_id,

    -- Convert unit_price to numeric
    CAST(REPLACE(unit_price, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) AS unit_price,

    product_category,
    product_type,
    product_detail,

    -- Calculate revenue
    transaction_qty * CAST(REPLACE(unit_price, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) AS total_amount,

    -- Extract hour,day name, week name and month name from timestamp
    HOUR(transaction_time) AS transaction_hour,
    DAYNAME(transaction_date) AS transaction_dayname,
    WEEKDAY(transaction_date) AS transaction_weekday,
    MONTHNAME(transaction_date) AS transaction_month

FROM bright.coffee.shop

),

coffee_sales_enriched AS (

SELECT
    *,

    -- Time Buckets
    CASE
        WHEN transaction_hour BETWEEN 6 AND 11 THEN 'Morning'
        WHEN transaction_hour BETWEEN 12 AND 17 THEN 'Afternoon'
        WHEN transaction_hour BETWEEN 18 AND 24 THEN 'Evening'
        ELSE 'Late Night'
    END AS transaction_time_bucket,

    ---- Weekend vs Weekday
    CASE
        WHEN DAYOFWEEK(transaction_date) IN (1,7)
        THEN 'Weekend'
        ELSE 'Weekday'
        END AS Day_Type,

    -- Sales Buckets
    CASE
        WHEN total_amount < 10 THEN 'Small Purchase'
        WHEN total_amount BETWEEN 10 AND 20 THEN 'Medium Purchase'
        ELSE 'Large Purchase'
    END AS sales_category

FROM coffee_sales_clean

)

SELECT *
FROM coffee_sales_enriched;



-----------------------------------Answering the CEO's questions------------------------------------

-----Query 1: Total Revenue ( This becomes a KPI Card in Power BI)
SELECT
    ROUND(SUM(transaction_qty * CAST(REPLACE(unit_price, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM coffee_sales_clean;


----Query 2: Revenue by Product Category (Visualization: Horizontal Bar Chart)

SELECT
    product_category,
    ROUND(SUM(transaction_qty * CAST(REPLACE(unit_price, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS revenue
FROM coffee_sales_clean
GROUP BY product_category
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

---Query 3: Best-Selling Products (Column Chart)
SELECT
    product_detail,
    SUM(transaction_qty) AS quantity_sold
FROM coffee_sales_clean
GROUP BY product_detail
ORDER BY quantity_sold DESC;

-----Query 4: Revenue by Product Type (Visualization: Top 10 Bar Chart)
SELECT
    product_type,
    ROUND(SUM(transaction_qty * CAST(REPLACE(unit_price, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS revenue
FROM coffee_sales_clean
GROUP BY product_type
ORDER BY revenue DESC;


------Query 5: Peak Sales Time(Visualization: Column Chart)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN HOUR(transaction_time) BETWEEN 6 AND 11 THEN 'Morning'
        WHEN HOUR(transaction_time) BETWEEN 12 AND 16 THEN 'Afternoon'
        WHEN HOUR(transaction_time) BETWEEN 17 AND 21 THEN 'Evening'
        ELSE 'Night'
    END AS transaction_time_bucket,
    ROUND(SUM(transaction_qty * CAST(REPLACE(unit_price, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS revenue
FROM coffee_sales_clean
GROUP BY transaction_time_bucket
ORDER BY revenue DESC;


-----Query 6: Revenue by Store(Visualization: Bar Chart)
SELECT
    store_location,
    ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS revenue
FROM coffee_sales_clean
GROUP BY store_location
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

---Query 7: Sales Category Distribution(Visualization: Donut Chart or Stacked Bar Chart)
SELECT
    sales_category,
    COUNT(*) AS transactions,
    ROUND(SUM(total_amount),2) AS revenue
FROM coffee_sales_clean
GROUP BY sales_category
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

-----Query 8: Revenue by Store and Product Category (Visualization: Stacked Bar Chart)

SELECT
    store_location,
    product_category,
    ROUND(SUM(total_amount),2) AS total_revenue
FROM coffee_sales_enriched
GROUP BY store_location, product_category
ORDER BY store_location, total_revenue DESC;

-- Data Cleaning & Transformation
-- Author: Charlotte Turya
-- ==========================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_coffee_sales AS

WITH coffee_sales_clean AS (

    SELECT
        transaction_id,
        transaction_date,
        transaction_time,
        transaction_qty,
        store_id,
        store_location,
        product_id,

        -- Convert unit_price from string to numeric
        CAST(REPLACE(unit_price, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) AS unit_price,

        product_category,
        product_type,
        product_detail,

        -- Calculate Total Sales Amount
        transaction_qty * CAST(REPLACE(unit_price, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) AS total_amount,

        -- Extract Hour from Transaction Time
        HOUR(transaction_time) AS transaction_hour

    FROM workspace.default.coffee_sales_clean

),

coffee_sales_enriched AS (

    SELECT
        *,

        -- Time of Day Buckets
        CASE
            WHEN transaction_hour BETWEEN 0 AND 11 THEN 'Morning'
            WHEN transaction_hour BETWEEN 12 AND 17 THEN 'Afternoon'
            WHEN transaction_hour BETWEEN 18 AND 24 THEN 'Evening'
            ELSE 'Very Late'
        END AS transaction_time_bucket,

        -- Sales Category
        CASE
            WHEN total_amount < 10 THEN 'Small Purchase'
            WHEN total_amount BETWEEN 10 AND 20 THEN 'Medium Purchase'
            ELSE 'Large Purchase'
        END AS sales_category,

        -- Day of Week
        DATE_FORMAT(transaction_date, 'EEEE') AS day_of_week,

        -- Month Name
        DATE_FORMAT(transaction_date, 'MMMM') AS month_name,

        -- Weekend / Weekday
        CASE
            WHEN DAYOFWEEK(transaction_date) IN (1,7) THEN 'Weekend'
            ELSE 'Weekday'
        END AS day_type

    FROM coffee_sales_clean

)

    product_category,
    product_type,
    product_detail,
    -- Convert unit_price to numeric
    CAST(REPLACE(unit_price, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) AS unit_price,
    -- Calculate total amount
    transaction_qty
      * CAST(REPLACE(unit_price, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) AS total_amount,
    -- Time analysis
    HOUR(transaction_time) AS transaction_hour,
    DAYNAME(transaction_date) AS day_name,
    MONTHNAME(transaction_date) AS month_name,
    -- Time bucket
    CASE
      WHEN HOUR(transaction_time) BETWEEN 6 AND 11 THEN 'Morning'
      WHEN HOUR(transaction_time) BETWEEN 12 AND 16 THEN 'Afternoon'
      WHEN HOUR(transaction_time) BETWEEN 17 AND 21 THEN 'Evening'
      ELSE 'Night'
    END AS time_bucket,
    -- Sales category with correct thresholds
    CASE
      WHEN transaction_qty * CAST(REPLACE(unit_price, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) < 5 THEN 'Small Purchase'
      WHEN
        transaction_qty * CAST(REPLACE(unit_price, ',', '.') AS DOUBLE) BETWEEN 5 AND 15
      THEN
        'Medium Purchase'
      ELSE 'Large Purchase'
    END AS sales_category,
    -- Weekend vs Weekday
    CASE
      WHEN DAYOFWEEK(transaction_date) IN (1, 7) THEN 'Weekend'
      ELSE 'Weekday'
    END AS day_type
  FROM
    bright.coffee.shop
)
SELECT
  *
FROM
  coffee_sales_clean
